name: 339. MiniMax speech reports billed characters and audio seconds, streamed or not (minimax speech usage) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-6629 regression, contract C5. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream (the minimax provider's base_url is the fixture's /pp/minimax). The fixture answers /v1/t2a_v2 with a recorded extra_info: usage_characters 37, audio_length 2500 ms, usage_voice_count 1. Both the streamed speech.audio.done and the non-streamed response's x-bifrost-usage header must carry billed_characters 37 and audio_seconds 3 (audio_seconds is an int, so the milliseconds are rounded up), and usage_voice_count, which has no unified field, must not appear. The non-streamed case reads the x-bifrost-usage header added by TXE-6530. Run the whole folder in order.

item.name: minimax/speech-2.8-turbo /v1/audio/speech stream_format sse: speech.audio.done carries billed_characters and audio_seconds (minimax speech usage)

exec: if (pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixture') !== '1') {
pm.execution.skipRequest();
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl') + '/__reset', method: 'POST' }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('minimax speech usage setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null);
pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200);
var FX = pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl');
// wire: the requests that reached the fixture, bytes as they arrived.

function wire(cb) { pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); }); cb(res.json().data[0].calls); }); }
function t2a(calls) { return calls.filter(function (c) { return c.path === '/pp/minimax/v1/t2a_v2'; }); }
// The fixture's recorded extra_info: usage_characters 37, audio_length 2500 ms, usage_voice_count 1.
function assertUsage(label, usage, text) {
pm.test(label + ': billed_characters is MiniMax usage_characters', function () { pm.expect(usage, text).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(usage.billed_characters, text).to.equal(37); });
pm.test(label + ': audio_seconds is audio_length 2500 ms rounded up', function () { pm.expect(usage.audio_seconds, text).to.equal(3); });
pm.test(label + ': usage_voice_count has no unified field and is not invented', function () { pm.expect(JSON.stringify(usage), text).to.not.include('voice_count'); });
var text = pm.response.text();
pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, text).to.equal(200); });
var done = null;

text.split('\n').forEach(function (line) { if (line.indexOf('data: ') !== 0) { return; } try { var ev = JSON.parse(line.slice(6)); if (ev.type === 'speech.audio.done') { done = ev; } } catch (e) {} });
pm.test('a speech.audio.done event arrived', function () { pm.expect(done, text).to.not.equal(null); });
assertUsage('streamed', (done || {}).usage, text);

wire(function (calls) { pm.test('exactly one upstream call, streamed', function () { var c = t2a(calls); pm.expect(c, JSON.stringify(calls)).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(JSON.parse(c[0].body).stream, c[0].body).to.equal(true); }); });

item.name: minimax/speech-2.8-turbo /v1/audio/speech non-streamed: the x-bifrost-usage header carries the same billed_characters and audio_seconds (minimax speech usage)

exec: if (pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixture') !== '1') {
pm.execution.skipRequest();
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl') + '/__reset', method: 'POST' }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('minimax speech usage setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null);
pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200);
var FX = pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl');
// wire: the requests that reached the fixture, bytes as they arrived.

function wire(cb) { pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); }); cb(res.json().data[0].calls); }); }
function t2a(calls) { return calls.filter(function (c) { return c.path === '/pp/minimax/v1/t2a_v2'; }); }
// The fixture's recorded extra_info: usage_characters 37, audio_length 2500 ms, usage_voice_count 1.
function assertUsage(label, usage, text) {
pm.test(label + ': billed_characters is MiniMax usage_characters', function () { pm.expect(usage, text).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(usage.billed_characters, text).to.equal(37); });
pm.test(label + ': audio_seconds is audio_length 2500 ms rounded up', function () { pm.expect(usage.audio_seconds, text).to.equal(3); });
pm.test(label + ': usage_voice_count has no unified field and is not invented', function () { pm.expect(JSON.stringify(usage), text).to.not.include('voice_count'); });
pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });
// The audio body has no room for usage; TXE-6530 carries the unified usage in x-bifrost-usage (contract C5).
var header = pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-usage');
var headers = JSON.stringify(pm.response.headers.toObject());
pm.test('the x-bifrost-usage header is present', function () { pm.expect(header, headers).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
var usage = null; try { usage = JSON.parse(header); } catch (e) {}
assertUsage('non-streamed', usage, headers);

wire(function (calls) { pm.test('exactly one upstream call, not streamed', function () { var c = t2a(calls); pm.expect(c, JSON.stringify(calls)).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(JSON.parse(c[0].body).stream, c[0].body).to.not.equal(true); }); });
